name: mediascan
short_description: Python tool for automatically organizing media files using intelligent filename parsing.
long_description: MediaScan is a Python package that scans directories and intelligently organizes media files (movies and TV shows) into a structured library. It uses multiple parsing libraries (guessit, PTN, and custom regex patterns) to accurately detect and extract metadata from media filenames, then organizes files according to configurable path templates. The tool supports multiple actions (symlink, hard link, copy, or move) and can filter files by size and extension, making it ideal for building organized media libraries from downloads or collections with inconsistent naming conventions.

modules.description: Core MediaScan class that handles file scanning, processing, and organization with support for multiple file actions (symlink, link, copy, move).
Advanced media filename parser combining guessit, PTN, and regex patterns to extract metadata (title, year, season, episode, resolution, codecs, language, etc.).
Command-line interface with argument parsing, config file support (YAML), and integration with MediaScan class for CLI execution.
Configuration module with default settings for paths, file extensions, output templates, file size thresholds, and logging configuration.
Logging setup using loguru with support for file rotation, console output, and configurable log levels.
Package initialization exposing MediaScan and Interpreter classes with version and metadata information.
